items.t: Coinbase Plans Its Own Prediction Markets by Mid-2027. That’s a New Rival for Robinhood
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCoinbase is reportedly aiming to launch its own prediction markets in the first half of 2027, moving beyond its Kalshi partnership. Coinbase needs the business more than Robinhood needs to worry about it, with analysts expecting a normalized loss in 2026.

items.t: Robinhood Markets vs. Nu: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.sum: Nu's forward P/E sits at 13.7 versus Robinhood's 38.3, yet the cheaper stock carries a different set of risks worth weighing.

items.t: Robinhood Just Dropped 29% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRobinhood stock fell 29% in the past month as crypto trading slumped, and Coinbase fell even harder in the same selloff. Robinhood’s crypto revenue fell 55% in the third quarter and its October crypto volume fell 48%, but prediction markets now bring in more revenue than crypto, and deposits keep growing.

items.t: Robinhood Markets vs. PayPal: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.sum: Robinhood's revenue jumped 51.6% last year, but PayPal trades at a far lower multiple, leaving investors to weigh growth against value.

items.t: Robinhood Faces Shareholder Proposal Over Proxy Voting Options as SEC Eases Oversight
items.sum: Robinhood Markets (NASDAQ:HOOD) is facing a shareholder proposal calling for a review of its proxy-voting services, amid concerns that retail investors have limited choices when participating in corporate elections and other shareholder decisions.
